sloka: ब्राह्मणः सुमहातेजाः तपो बल समन्वितः ।उद्धरिष्यति रंभे त्वाम् मत् क्रोध कलुषी कृताम् ॥१-६४-१३॥
transliteration: brāhmaṇaḥ sumahātejāḥ tapo bala samanvitaḥ ।uddhariṣyati raṁbhe tvām mat krodha kaluṣī kṛtām ॥1-64-13॥

translations.english: 'O Rambha an effulgent brahmin, endowed with the power of asceticism, will liberate you from this state into which you have fallen on account of my anger'.
